Definition: the new moon; by implication, a month
BiblicalUsage: Chodesh is the new moon and the month, the turning of the moon that sets God's calendar. The Lord tells Moses this month shall be the beginning of months, the law orders offerings at the new moon, Solomon begins the temple in the month Zif, and Esther's twelve months of purifying end in the month of her going to the king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the new moon teaches me that God marks time for His people, and every month begins with Him. I hold that a calendar set by God is a gift, because it keeps worship at the centre of the year.
RelatedEvents: The Passover; Building of Solomon's Temple
